name: monitoring_run_id
description: uuid4 hex of the attempt.

name: status
description: succeeded, refused or failed.

name: failed_stage
description: clock, score or evaluate when not succeeded.

name: started_at
description: Wall clock (UTC) when the attempt started.

name: finished_at
description: started_at plus the monotonic elapsed time.

name: sim_date
description: The simulated date; null when the clock failed or the date was invalid.

name: cadence
description: burn_in, weekly, dispatch or catch_up; null when not resolved or invalid.

name: trigger
description: laptop, or the GitHub Actions event name.

name: github_run_url
description: The Actions run, when run in Actions.

name: git_commit
description: Commit of the monitoring code.

name: git_dirty
description: Uncommitted changes on a laptop run; null in Actions.

name: github_run_attempt
description: GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT (1 for a first attempt); null on the laptop.

name: history_tests_passed
description: Whether monitoring.sql passed before this row; null when not run (clock-stage rows).

name: scoring_run_id
description: The score stage's scoring_runs attempt.

name: model_bundle_id
description: The monitored bundle.

name: gold_fingerprint
description: Fingerprint of the gold the labels came from.

name: gold_fingerprint_definition
description: Its definition.

name: verdict
description: ok, alert, insufficient_data or incomplete_cohort; non-null iff succeeded.

name: cohort_start
description: First discharge day of the matured cohort.

name: cohort_end
description: Day after its last discharge day (exclusive).

name: n_matured
description: Matured cohort rows.

name: observed
description: Observed readmissions in the matured cohort.

name: expected
description: Sum of predicted probabilities in the matured cohort.

name: oe_ratio
description: Observed / expected.

name: oe_ci_low
description: Exact Poisson 95% lower bound of the ratio.

name: oe_ci_high
description: Exact Poisson 95% upper bound of the ratio.

name: auc
description: ROC-AUC of the matured cohort (report only).

name: n_label_after_sim
description: Matured rows whose label depends on records after the simulated date.

name: n_immature
description: Scored discharges whose labels are not yet mature.

name: expected_immature
description: Label-free expected positives of the immature cohort.

name: coverage_required
description: Ticks the cohorts need (18).

name: coverage_found
description: Of those, ticks with complete published predictions.

name: min_positives_floor
description: The pre-registered floor applied.

name: band_low
description: The pre-registered band's lower edge.

name: band_high
description: The pre-registered band's upper edge.

name: error_type
description: Exception class of a failed or refused attempt.

name: error_message
description: Its message (4,000 characters at most).
